rules.rationale: Unconditionally expands the proof-only name charLoopBody to the exact MPY statement tree for the source loop body; it defines a named proof term and is not an execution rule.
Unconditionally expands afterCharLoop to the exact final conditional-append and return statement tree, so it is a named-term definition rather than an operational semantic rule.
Defines selectWordsBody by composing the exact initialization statements, loop term, and post-loop term used in the proof.
Defines the flushSelected count-mismatch branch: no word is selected and the accumulator is returned unchanged.
Defines the flushSelected equal-count, empty-word branch, which returns the accumulator without creating an empty output word.
Defines the flushSelected equal-count, nonempty-word branch by appending that word to the accumulated ValSeq.
Defines selectScan as the composition of the scan accumulator, final word, final count, and final flush summaries.
Defines the scanAccum base case on an empty remaining character sequence by returning the accumulated selected words.
Defines the delimiter and count-mismatch scanAccum recurrence: discard the current word, reset its count, and recurse on the tail.
Defines the delimiter, equal-count, empty-current-word scanAccum recurrence, resetting state without appending an empty word.
Defines the delimiter, equal-count, nonempty-current-word scanAccum recurrence by appending the word, resetting state, and recursing.
Defines the non-space vowel scanAccum recurrence: extend the current word, leave the consonant count unchanged, and consume one character.
Defines the non-space non-vowel scanAccum recurrence: extend the current word, increment the consonant count, and consume one character.
Defines the wordAfter base case: with no remaining characters, the current word is the final word.
Defines the wordAfter delimiter recurrence by resetting the current word and recursing on the remaining characters.
Defines the wordAfter non-delimiter recurrence by concatenating the character to the current word and consuming it.
Defines the countAfter base case: with no remaining characters, the current count is final.
Defines the countAfter delimiter recurrence by resetting the count to zero and consuming the delimiter.
Defines the countAfter non-space vowel recurrence, which consumes the character without changing the count.
Defines the countAfter non-space non-vowel recurrence, which consumes the character and increments the count.
Defines the charAfter base case: when the suffix is empty, the previously stored loop character remains final.
Defines the charAfter recurrence by storing the current one-character string and consuming one input character.
